resources.string: Optional bedtime and alarm guard. SleepWell uses only window package and class names, not screen contents or typed text. It can redirect distracting apps during bedtime and return to a ringing challenge. Optional power-menu protection dismisses recognised shutdown menus only during a real alarm; forced hardware restart remains possible. Settings, calls and emergency screens remain accessible. Enable this only if you want these controls; disable the service here at any time.
